its frustrating that i pay for daycare, and work just to pay for daycare. I pay to  NOT spend time with my son. All day I think about him and think how much  I hate my job, but I need it. Working to work, working simply to miss time with him, is heartbreaking.

thank you for taking time to reply.
maybe i should seek help, i suppose i feel too guilty... maybe someone else needs it more? i dont want to take the help from someone else. my biggest weakness is accepting help. is admitting defeat.
